upstream.description: Build your own data-driven market edge with swing-trade signal webhooks, dashboards, alerts, AI agents, and automation examples.

classification.analysis: A public starter kit showing how to consume KamdenAI's swing-trade signal webhooks and route them into Discord alerts, Google Sheets logs, a private dashboard, Make/Zapier workflows, or AI-agent prompt summaries. It ships example Node and Python webhook receivers, signature verification docs, and sample payloads, but deliberately excludes the proprietary signal-generation logic itself — it's an integration-layer reference, not the trading product. Aimed at traders/developers who already have (or want) a KamdenAI membership and need to wire signal events into their own tools.

use_cases.title: Route trading signal webhooks into Discord or Sheets
Prototype a trading signal dashboard from sample payloads
Build a no-code automation recipe for signal events
